newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Life wind-up plan ready in 2-3 weeks - group.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Life wind-up plan ready in 2-3 weeks - group.

text.p: A scheme to wind up Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co is expected to be ready in two to three weeks, Kenjiro Hata, chairman of the Life Insurance Association of Japan, said on Friday.

Hata told a news conference that the insurance body wants to seek capital contributions from related companies such as Nissan Motor Co Ltd and Hitachi Ltd if a new company is set up to take over Nissan Life's business.
Nissan Motor is a major customer of Nissan Life. The insurer holds shares in both Nissan Motor and Hitachi.

The insurance body will make utmost efforts to protect Nissan Life's policyholders and it is possible there may be a rise in the upper limit of funds, now at 200 billion yen, to be disbursed from the policyholder protection fund which has been set up to protect policyholders against a failure of a life insurer.
"It is possible to raise the upper limit of the fund," said Hata.
